commands.name: /harness
commands.description: 打开 harness 面板；列出当前所有 flow 状态

commands.name: /harness verify
commands.description: 对 MR/分支跑测试 + checklist

commands.name: /harness approve
commands.description: 显式批准指定 flow 的产物（kind 同 spec validKinds）

commands.name: /harness continue
commands.description: 继续 paused flow（如 merge 冲突解决后）

commands.name: /harness diagnose
commands.description: 显示 harness-kit 当前状态诊断

commands.name: /harness check
commands.description: 跑指定 flow 的 reference checklist

commands.name: /harness focus
commands.description: 在 form A (drawer) / B (details) / C (badge) 之间循环切换

commands.name: /harness reload
commands.description: 显式重载 harness-kit preset（运行中会话新 preset 仅下次会话生效）
